messages.speaker: Ari · Clinic coordinator
messages.text: Riverbend opens next month. Equip reception, a mobile nurse, a week-at-home wearable and central records. Build and test the local network, repair the inherited nurse setting, choose access permissions and leave a handover. Use only synthetic markers; do not enter names or patient information.

messages.speaker: Ari · Clinic coordinator
messages.text: The service fee is 120 fictional credits. Each technical-guide section reserves 5 credits and adds 3 simulated consultation minutes, capped at 15 credits and 9 minutes. Reopening and all hint levels are included. The brief, controls, glossary and diagnostics remain free.

messages.speaker: Mina · Nurse
messages.text: Could nurses also arrange follow-up bookings? I value the flexibility, but reception-only booking is a reasonable boundary. Please decide and explain the trade-off.

messages.speaker: Ari · Clinic coordinator
messages.text: The intake service received all seven nonclinical day markers. This is a delayed return-and-sync transfer, not live home monitoring.

messages.speaker: Ari · Clinic coordinator
messages.text: Your recorded explanations are included. Your handover is ready for teacher review.

fault.evidenceType: Early correction or no recorded pre-repair player failure; no failure is invented

objectives.label: Equip all four jobs and the network
objectives.detail: Reception, mobile nurse, wearable, records host, switch and access point need suitable capabilities.

objectives.label: Restore bookings and workspace in both rooms
objectives.detail: Powered links, correct unique addresses, services and required access must agree.

objectives.label: Repair the inherited nurse address
objectives.detail: Early repair is allowed; the report will say no pre-repair player failure was observed.

objectives.label: Collect, return, transfer and upload seven markers
objectives.detail: 7/7 collected · 7/7 handed off · 7/7 received. These are nonclinical test markers.

objectives.label: Allow required work and restrict other roles
objectives.detail: An expected denial counts only when the network and service are healthy.

objectives.label: Run a fresh complete test suite
objectives.detail: All final checks must refer to the current technical revision. Handover runs this suite again.

objectives.label: Prepare four explanations or oral follow-up
objectives.detail: Your own explanations are preserved; their quality remains for teacher review.

evidenceSnapshot.teacherReview: Pending teacher judgement. Completion, support use and income do not assign a grade or mastery.
modelLimitations: One static local subnet; no Internet, router, DHCP or DNS is required or simulated.
Wi-Fi coverage is a named-location rule, not a radio propagation model.
Role permissions are simulated application authorization, not real account authentication or a complete security system.
Seven synthetic day markers and return-and-sync do not represent clinical measurements or live remote monitoring.
Local files are editable evidence, not tamper-proof records.
